description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pubudu Pura, Nagenahira Nuwaragam Palatha D/S/Division, Anuradhapura District.
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Plot 100, Block 01) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and title classification. The content focuses entirely on land property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
